subject.title: [Feature]: Customisable TUI input prompt (e.g., agent name prefix)

question: Should OpenClaw add a persisted `tui.input.prompt` configuration surface, or should TUI context stay in the footer/status UI?
rationale: The request is useful ergonomics, but the repository policy sets a high bar for new config options and current TUI already exposes agent/session/model context in the footer.

options.title: Add a narrow prompt config
options.body: Accept the feature with schema/help/docs/tests and keep it strictly TUI-local with an empty default.

options.title: Keep context in the footer
options.body: Decline the new config surface for now and treat footer/status improvements as the supported context display path.

options.title: Prototype before contract
options.body: Ask for a maintainer-owned experiment or design note before committing to a persistent config key.

recommendation.title: Keep context in the footer
recommendation.body: Decline the new config surface for now and treat footer/status improvements as the supported context display path.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the broadest sampled TUI/config/docs history and is the best available owner for the product-surface decision.
